directive.quote: its correct parts move one to one.

preserve: Keep the original standing-instructions job and its source-defined limits, validation, refusal and recovery behavior.
Keep the complete selected source functions or command branch active in the canonical target.
allowed_deltas: Relocate local imports and settings data paths to their Workshop owners.
Use the shared Workshop content-identity owner for BLAKE3 where the old source imported its dependency directly.
banned_substitutions: Do not replace source mechanisms with an independent rewrite.
Do not leave a second live owner in the source repository.
Do not use an archival source copy as active retention proof.

proof.verification_state: Not yet verified: integration, source retirement where required, scoped tests and final shared judge remain.
